sources.promotionPolicy: never_link_by_name; confirm identifier semantics, then reconcile to GRH persona document assertion and employment contract with collision review
site verification required; coordinates remain restricted and device serial, firmware, time source, protocol, owner and connectivity must be certified
responsible names are processed only in the private tenant data plane; counts are estimates until owner, definition and cutoff are certified

securityAndPrivacyRules: Every point, device, connector, employee eligibility and event is tenant-bound.
Raw punch events are append-only, idempotent and preserve device/source time plus ingestion time.
A WhatsApp number is a challenge-delivery channel, never the source of employment identity or authorization.
WhatsApp challenges and workplace PINs are short-lived, single-use, rate-limited and bound to tenant, actor, purpose and marking point.
Location is captured at punch time by default; continuous tracking is disabled unless separately justified, approved and governed.
Exact coordinates are restricted and never exposed in public reports or URLs.
Biometric templates remain on the device or an approved local controller; central biometric storage is out of scope until legal, privacy and security review.
Every calculated minute must explain source event, assignment, calendar, shift, rule version and human exception.

phases.outcome: Homologate area aliases, point ownership, roster identifier semantics and current coverage without importing row values into Git.
Create tenant-bound point and device fleet catalog with serial, firmware, clock drift, health, protocol, secret reference and local owner.
Ingest network and controlled offline files into an immutable raw-event ledger with deduplication, quarantine and replay.
Enable governed web, QR, rotating PIN and WhatsApp challenge marking with punch-time geofence and non-biometric fallback.
Generate expected calendars and explainable exceptions from approved 011 catalogs, then maker-checker review and payroll export preview.
Operate multi-government connector fleet with tenant isolation, observability, SLA, disaster recovery and audited support access.
